paragraphs.text: Jherana Rure was a commander of the Order of the Ebon Hand on the Dominarian continent of Sarpadia .

When the Thrulls of Sarpadia - created by Endrek Sahr - became more self-confident after the visit of Reod Dai , intelligent thrull varieties turned the species as a whole against their masters. Jherana Rure became the commander of the counterinsurgency against the thrull army. She was eventually killed by Necrites, ending the counterinsurgency in a single blow.
